_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture 20260801145510 / 20260801145504). Two shots per weapon: SELECT PRIMARY WEAPON for the text and stats, CUSTOMIZE for the art. TBD is deliberate: anything not legible on screen stays TBD rather than becoming a plausible-looking guess. Unlock is the Season 4 Battle Pass, per the project owner 2026-08-03: new guns ship in the Battle Pass for their launch season and only move to seasonal catch-up challenges once that season ends, so there is no challenge Requirement row while the season is current. NOTE: the SELECT screen renders this weapon's PRECISION as a greyed-out 000 with an empty bar, unlike every other rifle in the category (17-45). Recorded as 0 because that is literally what the screen shows, but it looks like the UI failed to populate it. Worth re-capturing before this is trusted.
name: EF88
